name: LOVESICK: FACE ME
source:
A horror/anti-dating sim that explores what it truly means to never really know who you're going to run into. 

Set in a small Appalachian town in the 90's, you play as a college student trying to get a photo of the town's infamous "faceless ghost" for your newspaper club's publication. What happens next is for you to decide!

[From [url=https://splatterrat.itch.io/lovesick-face-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款恐怖/反约会模拟游戏，探索永远不知道自己会遇到谁的真正含义。

以90年代的阿巴拉契亚小镇为背景，你扮演一名大学生，试图为你的报纸俱乐部的出版物拍摄该镇臭名昭著的“无脸幽灵”的照片。接下来发生的事情由你决定！

[来自[url=https://splatterrat.itch.io/lovesick-face-me]itch.io[/url]]
